title: `voids/the-silence-void` reverses its main source — Laukkonen et al. 2023 call nirodha "outwardly comparable to general anesthesia" (preliminary single-meditator data; transformation "yet to be tested"), but L50/L70/L96 say the opposite and L78 "not unconsciousness" contradicts the page's own L50 definition; L76/L108 infer contentless awareness from cessation (the source: pure-consciousness states occur "before or after cessation, but not during"); four quotations misattributed (Davis's prose as Heidegger's; "disponibilité" line absent from *Discourse on Thinking*; Forman "definition" is a Goodreads blurb; "Ferrara & Ferrara" is Sans Pinillos 2023)
